title: Financial Counseling Note: Approved Hardship Applications and Non-Covered Strip Charges
content:
A customer's approved hardship application on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program reduces a non-covered item patient charge on a denied test-strip line.

**Note.** When the program has a hardship application with request status approved that was received within the last 12 calendar months, the charge is reduced to 0.6 of itself; when its approved hardship application is older, to 0.8; and otherwise it is not reduced; a date falls within the last 12 calendar months when it is later than the same calendar day 12 months earlier.

**Q. Which applications count?** Only hardship applications on the program whose request status is approved. An application that is received, denied or withdrawn does not reduce the charge.

**Q. What if there is one recent and one older approved application?** The recent one decides: 0.6.

**Q. Where is the 12-month boundary? (hypothetical: today is 10 March)** An approved application received on 11 March of the previous year is within the last 12 calendar months; one received on 10 March of the previous year is older.

**Worked figures (hypothetical charge of 80.00)**

| Approved hardship application | Charge |
|---|---|
| received within the last 12 calendar months | 48.00 |
| only older ones | 64.00 |
| none | 80.00 |
